**#2970 (NIP-17 wss-only gate blocks nak serve) — DEFER post-v1.**
- Verdict: keep open as a test-harness task; do NOT relax the parser gate.
- Justification: Owner already confirmed (issue comment) this is a pure local-testability gap, not a defect — validated e2e vs wss://nos.lol, downgraded to p3, does not block v1. I rejected the `cfg(test)`/feature relaxation on its merits: (a) it buys nothing for Rust tests — the gate lives only in `parse_dm_relay_list`; `DmRelayCache::upsert` doesn't gate scheme, so a test can seed the cache directly; (b) it does nothing for the actual manual `nak serve` loop — that runs through an app binary, not a `cargo test` build, so `cfg(test)` never applies, and a cargo feature enabled for validation would validate the wrong confidentiality posture (a footgun + forked NIP-17 §2 invariant). Correct closures are non-invasive: an in-workspace integration test that injects a `ws://` DmRelayCache entry directly (bypassing the parser), or a cert-trusted wss local-relay recipe (mkcert in front of nak serve — the non-trivial part is client cert trust). Neither is triage-sized, so deferred to the next NIP-17 validation pass.
- Action: comment #2970#issuecomment-4881977806, label `phase:post-v1`. [...] Assistant: The misc opus agent returned well-reasoned defer verdicts (rightly rejected relaxing the NIP-17 security gate, and deferred the signer_state split as a reconciliation task with a duplicate-path risk). Labels + comments already applied. I'll sync the board.

Assistant: #2970 and #2993 → Backlog (post-v1, both correctly deferred, not forced). Remaining: #3004, #2962 (sonnet slam-dunks), #3010, #3005 (opus fixes) still working toward PRs.
